name: Kamikaze Rush
author: Addicting Games
description: Kamikaze Rush is a free endless racing game. There is nothing like the rush of a kamikaze charge. Whether you're dodging heaving pyramids or sliding obelisks you'll love the high-speed challenge and never-ending courses of this endless racer game. An endless racer game is a game that never ends until you die. The levels just get faster and the obstacles are harder to overcome, but the longer you play the more choice you have. As you race through the game you'll see floating blue circles. Navigate towards and through these circles and you will score cash you can use to upgrade your ride. Get a new paint job, buy a slimmer model, and even manipulate the value of your score, it is all up to you. You can either customize your ride for fun or trick it out so that it is an optimized racing machine. Either way, the fun never ends in this fast-paced, futuristic, free for all. So, strap in and take off! Kamakazi Rush is a fast-paced game where you'll either win big or die fast. Your speed determines your outcome. Just move fast and avoid the rectangles as they throb in and out of the ground.
